mapper.select: SELECT stat_time statTime FROM traffic_port_active_statistic order by stat_time desc limit 1
SELECT port ,SUM(sum) sum from traffic_port_active_statistic WHERE stat_time > DATE_SUB(#{statTime},INTERVAL 1 hour) GROUP BY port order by sum desc limit 0,10

SELECT SUM(sum) sum from traffic_port_active_statistic WHERE port=#{port} and stat_time < DATE_SUB(#{statTime},INTERVAL 1 hour) and stat_time > DATE_SUB(#{statTime},INTERVAL 2 hour) GROUP BY port ORDER BY sum DESC limit 0,10
